name: Vaigai

sink.name: Near Uchipuli, close to Pamban Bridge
sink.location: Ramanathapuram district, Tamil Nadu, Palk Strait

did_you_know: Celebrated in Sangam-era Tamil literature as 'Kritamaala', the Vaigai is said to encircle the temple city of Madurai like a garland.
Much of its flow today comes not from its own catchment but from the Periyar-Vaigai project, which tunnels water from the Periyar River in Kerala across the Western Ghats.
It rarely floods and is often reduced to a dry, sandy bed for long stretches, despite being the longest river south of the Kaveri delta.
